0x0049CA00 loads three BMP textures via sub_53CFE0 (0x0053CFE0) and allocates animation-control memory via sub_53CB20 (0x0053CB20).
sub_53CBC0 (0x0053CBC0) opens or references a container; the written handle is released with PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval (0x0053CE40).

disputes.description: In 0x0049B0A0 the container load is treated as failed when the return value is non-zero (guard `if (!result)` then builds the widgets), while 0x0049CA00 tests the written out-handle v8 for non-null to decide whether textures can be loaded. The return value and the written handle therefore carry different meanings across call sites; the packet does not resolve which is the status signal.

The IR label VehicleNodeCreateWithAudioVisual and its 2D-rectangle/audio-sound operations conflict with the only caller 0x0049CA00, which passes five offsets of one gauge object as if creating LED sub-elements. The owner class and the element layout are not established from this packet.

0x0049B0A0 consumes off_5CCB54[0] as a path string component inside the format call, while 0x0049CD80 treats the same global as the head of a linked list to search. Both uses cannot be a plain vtable entry; the exact identity is unknown.
